translations.text: He made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure, which he had established in himself from the beginning.
For the plan to be carried out when the times reach their fulfillment: to bring everything together in Christ, both the things in heaven and the things on earth, in him.
So that we who believed in Christ Jesus from the beginning might be for the praise of his glory.
So that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in knowing him.
It is not from works, so that no one may boast.
For at that time you were without Christ, excluded from the citizenship of Israel and strangers to the covenants of the promise, having no hope and being without God in the world.
This was not made known to human beings in other generations as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and the prophets through the Spirit.
So that Christ may dwell in the inner person, in your hearts, through faith.
So I say this and testify in the Lord: you must no longer live as the Gentiles live, in the emptiness of their hearts, with their thoughts darkened.
Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
So that he might make her holy, having cleansed her by the word and the washing with water.
Husbands, too, ought to love their wives in this way, as their own bodies. Whoever loves his wife loves himself.
Honor your father and your mother, which is the first commandment with a promise.
For this I serve as an ambassador in chains, so that I may speak boldly about it, as I ought to speak.
